Select distinct molecule identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against target CHEMBL1741186 in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741186' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
